I have set up and enhanced your **Tailor Measurement Book** application in [index.html](https://github.com/auwalabashir2020-droid/hi/blob/main/index.html).

### What's included:
- **Men's & Women's Categories**: Dedicated measurement fields for Men (Shoulder, Hannu/Sleeve, Body Length, Trouser Length, Neck, Chest) and Women (Bust, Shoulder, Body Length, Hips, Sleeve, Gown, Skirt Length).
- **Fixed DOM Identifier Bug**: Addressed a critical JavaScript conflict where `name` referenced `window.name`, ensuring saving works reliably across all browsers.
- **WhatsApp & Copy Shortcuts**: Quick buttons to copy structured measurement cards or send them straight to customers and tailors over WhatsApp.
- **Direct Calling**: Clickable phone numbers (`tel:`) to call customers directly from mobile.
- **Search & Filter**: Real-time filtering by customer name, phone number, or fabric/style notes.
- **Data Safety & Backup**: JSON backup import/export and CSV spreadsheet export, stored safely in browser storage.
- **Mobile Responsive Design**: Clean card interface with touch-friendly controls.

### 📲 How to Install Tailor Book on Your Phone or PC

The app is now fully configured as an installable **Progressive Web App (PWA)** with offline support.

👉 **Open this link on your phone or computer:**  
**[https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e46b2319-bb12-4c0b-b5c8-3ac97d41c8f2/95fb06459bc9c5a1f1b61dbe/](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/e46b2319-bb12-4c0b-b5c8-3ac97d41c8f2/95fb06459bc9c5a1f1b61dbe/)**

---

### Step-by-Step Installation:

#### 🤖 On Android (Chrome / Samsung Internet):
1. Open the link above in Chrome.
2. Tap the **"Install"** banner at the top (or tap the **three dots ⋮** in the top right corner).
3. Select **"Install App"** (or **"Add to Home screen"**).
4. Tap **Install**. The **Tailor Book** icon will now appear on your home screen and in your apps list!

#### 🍏 On iPhone / iPad (Safari):
1. Open the link above in **Safari**.
2. Tap the **Share icon** at the bottom (the square with an arrow pointing up: **⎋**).
3. Scroll down and tap **"Add to Home Screen"**.
4. Tap **Add** in the top right corner. The app will be placed directly on your phone's screen.

#### 💻 On Computer (Chrome / Edge):
1. Open the link in Chrome or Edge.
2. Click the **Install** button on the page or the **install icon (⊕)** in the browser address bar.

---

### Key Features Once Installed:
- **Works 100% Offline**: Open and manage your customer measurements even without mobile data or WiFi.
- **Fast Standalone App**: Launches full-screen like a regular native app without browser bars.
- **WhatsApp Integration**: Share measurements with customers or cutting assistants with one tap.
